subject: ggplot2 when pulling in data from Tiingo

messages.author: 779d90930a14cbd1
messages.subject: ggplot2 when pulling in data from Tiingo
parts:
Hello Everyone!

Hope all is well by you. I am having a bit of an issue. I am pulling data from tiingo to try and graph the last price over the course of a year. Everytime I try to graph the information I am given an error that there isn't an X value. Now, I assumed that when I see the date being pulled in it is automatically a part of the data frame. 
                    UAA.Close
2019-02-27     22.52
2019-02-28     22.55
2019-03-01     22.86
2019-03-04     22.27
2019-03-05     22.31
2019-03-06     21.76

Do you know how I can somehow create these dates the value of the x axis?

Really appreciate all and any help.

All the best,

Julia

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 when pulling in data from Tiingo
parts:
Julia, 

From the small clip of your data it looks like your dates are stored as rownames. In the tibble package of the tidyverse there is a function for this:
https://tibble.tidyverse.org/reference/rownames.html

Quite a few options in this SO post for doing the conversion as well. 

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/29511215/convert-row-names-into-first-column

If that doesn't work or solve your issue, consider following the directions at the bottom of this email to create a reproducible example with your issue and sample data. 

HTH, 
Brandon
